about: On every text, flowdown builds its tree in no more time than pulldown-cmark pulls its events (results/parse.json, built for speed).
Over the whole corpus, flowdown reads at least 1.1 times as fast as pulldown-cmark and 3 times as fast as comrak.
A read allocates a handful of times, not once a node: at most 32 allocations for any one text.
A reply read again as it streams costs no more than with pulldown-cmark, and no single read of it takes 1 ms (results/stream.json).
Every text built to be slow costs at most 6 times as much at four times its size: 16 would be quadratic (results/worst.md).
